Per our discussion, attached is a concise MAP and commercial proposal that ties BrightBridge's evaluation milestones to staged pricing/credits and two optional add-ons: extended observability retention and premium support. High-level summary below; full details are in redwood-map-proposal-v2.pdf attached.

Proposed MAP (milestones & commercial impact)
- M1 (2 weeks): POC kickoff, basic integration, 7-day pilot. No commit, complementary evaluation credits: 50k tokens.
- M2 (by EOW +4w): Performance evaluation — 1 representative workload at 2k qps token distribution. If latency targets met, we issue a 10% unit-price credit for the first month after GA.
- M3 (by +8w): Ramp to committed baseline — BrightBridge to commit to a 3-month reserved capacity (monthly commit). In return: 20% discount on committed units + 200k one-time onboarding credits.
- M4 (by +12w): Production go-live and SLA enrollment. If go-live is within target window, unlock extended observability retention upgrade (from 30 days to 13 months) as an add-on at a discounted rate (we can include first month free).

Add-ons & packaging changes (optional)
- Observability retention upgrade (13 months): normally charged, we propose 50% off for first 6 months if M3 commit met.
- Premium support (24/7 with named TAM): $X/month; first 30 days included if M2 success criteria met.
- Add-on credits: onboarding credits (200k tokens) applied upon signed SOW.

Key asks from BrightBridge to accelerate close
1) Signed MAP + SOW by 03/05/2026.
2) PO or procurement signal for the M3 commit window.
3) Security questionnaire return by 02/26/2026 (we already shared SOC2 + pen-test evidence).

Attached: redwood-map-proposal-v2.pdf (MAP + commercial appendix), SOW-draft.docx, pricing–matrix.csv

If this reads OK I’ll draft a short mutual-action timeline doc for signatures and route the SOW to legal.

Best,
